svg.aria-label: Dynamo-style key-value store. Nodes sit on a consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes; each key is stored on the next N equals 3 distinct nodes clockwise. A client sends a put to any node, which acts as coordinator, writes to the 3 replicas and returns once W equals 2 acknowledge; a get reads from R equals 2 and returns the newest version, repairing stale replicas. If a replica is down, a neighbour accepts the write with a hint and hands it back later (hinted handoff). Concurrent versions are detected with version vectors or resolved last-write-wins. Background anti-entropy compares Merkle trees between replicas. Gossip spreads cluster membership and failure suspicion. Each node stores data in an LSM-tree.
